description: Put JPG and PNG images into one PDF, one image per page, in the order given. Images are embedded as they are, without re-compression.

inputs.description: JPG or PNG paths, in page order.

output.description: Where to write the result. Defaults to a new file beside the input. Existing files are never overwritten; a free name like file-1.pdf is used instead.

page_size.description: "fit" makes each page the size of its image; "a4" and "letter" centre the image on a standard page.

name: images_to_pdf
title: Images to PDF
